meta.title: {{name}} — transitions for Minecraft video creators
meta.description: Pick a template, tweak parameters, preview in real time, and export alpha-channel transition clips. A free, open-source desktop app.

hero.lead: {{name}} is a desktop app: pick a template, tweak parameters, preview in real time, and export clips with an alpha channel to drop straight onto your timeline.
hero.noWebgl: WebGL2 is unavailable in this browser, so the live preview cannot run.
hero.demoAssets: This page uses generated flat demo colors; the desktop app reads your local game and resource packs.
hero.mcAssets: Block and item textures on this page come from Minecraft {{version}}, © Mojang / Microsoft, shown here for demonstration only. The desktop app reads your installed game and packs; no game files ship with it.

workflow.title: From launch to export in three steps.
workflow.lead: Pick a template, fine-tune its parameters, and export clean alpha footage. Click any step or control on the left to drive the live render on the right.

pick.title: Choose a transition or overlay.
pick.body: The desktop app ships a full library of transitions and overlays and lets you write custom TypeScript templates. Click any featured sample below:

tune.title: Adjust parameters in real time.
tune.body: Columns, entrance order, and spin immediately update the live engine via setParams. Try tweaking Block wipe below:

export.title: Export ready-to-edit alpha clips.
export.body: Export ProRes 4444, PNG sequences, WebM VP9, or greenscreen MP4. Every exported frame matches the preview frame for frame.
export.done: Export complete — drop directly onto your upper track

templates.title: Start with a few highlights.
templates.lead: Every tile is rendered live by the engine right inside your browser — not pre-recorded video. Download the desktop app for the complete library and custom templates.
templates.moreBody: Each template is a manifest plus a TypeScript script. Follow the authoring guide to build your own and export it just like built-ins.

alpha.title: Alpha-channel exports
alpha.body: Layer directly on top of your footage with zero chroma-keying. Rendered live from the engine below.
alpha.drag: Drag slider to compare transparent and composited views

formats.title: Formats for every NLE
formats.body: True alpha channels for pro editors, plus greenscreen MP4 where needed.

items.name: ProRes 4444 (Alpha)
items.apps: Premiere · DaVinci Resolve · Final Cut Pro

stack.title: Bring your own resource packs
stack.body: Three stacked layers — built-in colors, vanilla assets, and custom resource packs — with upper layers winning. Click a layer to inspect:

offline.title: Offline & sandboxed
offline.body: No accounts, telemetry, or third-party tracking. Template scripts execute inside an isolated Web Worker with these globals removed:

open.title: Open, free, and built together.
open.lead: Source code is public on GitHub under the GPL-3.0 license. Issues, templates, and pull requests are welcome.
